component.name: Luma Platform
component.summary: Shared libraries and the Luma application kit

description.p: The Luma Platform is the Flatpak runtime for Luma applications. It is built from the same Fedora 44 packages as the Luma operating system, including Luma's GTK 4, libadwaita, the Luma Developer Platform, the Prairie icon theme and Luma's fonts, so an application looks and behaves the same on Luma and on any other distribution with Flatpak.
